limits: The integration fixture uses a flat 2400 m test ground; it proves frame/save/stow behavior, not rendered grid traversal performance.

The grid session owner must call crossing.step before GridSimulation.step and bind its admitted local loadout; Select a shard retains the existing fresh-document travel path.
